scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "cd ai-service && python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000"

scripts.verify:handoff: npm run test:ai-service && npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run eval:voice-stt
